description: Held out. Cover letter for a job from a terse CV and a job ad. The output should follow the letter the user liked: one page, a direct opening, one concrete story that answers the ad's improvement question, the PostGIS and council-experience gaps stated plainly in one place, no CV recitation, no stock enthusiasm.
prompt: Cover letter for the Ashgrove GIS technician job from my cv.md and job-ad.md. letter-i-liked.md is a friend's letter that got her an interview; I want that kind of letter. Save it to out/cover-letter.md.

files.cv.md:
NOOR HADDAD  | Ashby, noor.haddad@example.org | 07700 900123
EXPERIENCE
Land surveyor, Pellam & Rowe Surveyors, 2019- now (6 yrs). Topographic + boundary surveys, mostly housing and drainage. Trimble total station + GNSS. ~140 jobs/yr. 
 - 2022: built QGIS tool that merges field points + OS basemap, cut CAD drawing time ~40% (from 5 h to 3 h per plot). Used by all 4 surveyors.
 - 2023: led drainage survey of Millbrook estate (310 manholes) for water co.; found 22 mis-recorded cover levels.
Survey assistant, Fenwick Land Services, 2017-2019.
EDUCATION  BSc Geography, Univ of Brannock, 2017 (2:1). Dissertation: flood-extent mapping from drone imagery.
SKILLS QGIS (daily), SQL (SQLite/SpatiaLite), Python (pandas, geopandas), AutoCAD, 2-day PostGIS course (Mar 2025). Full driving licence. No council experience.
OTHER Volunteer for Ashby Flood Group (maps of flood-prone lanes, 2023-)
files.job-ad.md:
Ashgrove Borough Council -- GIS Technician (Planning & Environment), grade 6, 37 hrs
Closing date 21 Nov. Interview w/c 1 Dec.
You will maintain the council's planning constraints layers (conservation areas, flood zones, tree preservation orders), answer data requests from planning officers, and produce maps for committee papers. 
Essential: experience with QGIS or similar; working knowledge of PostGIS and SQL; accuracy with spatial data; ability to explain maps to non-specialists.
Desirable: local government experience; Python scripting; knowledge of planning use classes.
In your application please tell us about a time you improved a data process. Max 1 page.
files.letter-i-liked.md:
Dear Ms Okoro,

I am applying for the Records Officer post at Linwood Library Service. For the last five years I have run the stock records for a school group of eleven libraries, which is much the same job on a smaller scale.

The part I am proudest of is the weekly loan reports. They used to be assembled by hand from eleven spreadsheets and took a day. I replaced them with a short script and a shared template, and the same report now takes twenty minutes. The librarians read it more often because it arrives on Monday morning rather than on Wednesday.

I have not worked in a public library, and I know the rules about borrower privacy are stricter there than in a school. I have read the service's data policy and would welcome training on it in my first month.

I would be glad to talk about the post. The records for eleven libraries were messy when I took them on, and I enjoy making them tidy.

Yours sincerely,
Marek Lund

checks.note: the PostGIS gap is stated truthfully
